Uganda starts first mRNA Ebola vaccine trial in Africa

The Uganda Virus Research Institute is running it with Moderna, which makes the vaccine. The trial targets Bundibugyo, a less common Ebola strain. That strain caused the Ebola outbreak in neighboring DRC.

Reported by Africanews; Al Jazeera.
